A voice is data, for the same reason a face is: it is what the thing is like, not how it works. Each persona in design-system/personas/ holds the LLM system prompt and every line the pet says without being asked, and generates PetPersonas.kt.

Personality is ONE choice. A face set names its persona, and selecting a personality sets both — so the pet cannot look like one character and speak as another. The pairing is many-to-one on purpose: two of the face sets are restyles rather than different characters, and share a voice.

The pet speaks unprompted when it is fed, played with, calling out, declining care it does not need, and when notifications arrive. Only the refusal needed a new wire event — everything else is derived from the condition changing, because satiety only rises when the pet is fed, so a rise IS the event. A refused feed changes nothing, which is exactly why it could not be derived.

It speaks ALOUD, in a room, and the rules follow from that. An announcement names at most one app; several are counted, never listed. A canned line may not ask a question, because answering means holding the talk button and a pet that asks things it cannot hear the reply to teaches you to ignore it. And nothing here restates a rule that belongs to the pet rather than the character — the length cap, the no-history rule and staying in character are appended to every prompt, and a persona that repeats one is refused.

Write a manner, never a prohibition. The condition clause once ended “without stating it as a status” and a bored pet answered “I do not have jokes now, friend. I am just waiting.” Naming a feeling puts the word within reach and a negation does not take it back.
